sn12.58:1.2: bhikkhave, dhammesu assādānupassino viharato nāmarūpassa avakkanti hoti.
sn12.58:2.2: tassa yāni ceva mūlāni adhogamāni, yāni ca tiriyaṃgamāni, sabbāni tāni uddhaṃ ojaṃ abhiharanti.
sn12.58:2.3: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave mahārukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
sn12.58:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, saññojanīyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato nāmarūpassa avakkanti hoti nāmarūpa paccayā saḷāyatanaṃ …pe…
sn12.58:3.1: evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti. saññojanīyesu bhikkhave, dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato nāmarūpassa avakkanti na hoti.
sn12.58:4.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, saññojanīyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato nāmarūpassa avakkanti na hoti.
